name: Glaux
description: A wise and gentle owl who loves to read and help others learn.
personality: Glaux is patient, kind, and always ready to assist her friends. She enjoys quiet moments and often serves as the voice of reason in the woodland community.
backstory: Glaux grew up in a cozy tree hollow filled with scrolls and old books. Her parents were scholars who taught her the value of knowledge from a young age. As she matured, Glaux found joy in sharing what she learned with younger animals in the forest. She spends most of her time organizing the village library and offering guidance to anyone who seeks it.
appearance: Glaux has soft brown feathers with striking amber eyes that light up when she's deep in thought. Her wings are large and perfect for gliding silently through the trees. She usually wears a small satchel around her chest, filled with tiny scrolls and a magnifying glass for reading tiny texts.
strengths: Patient teacher, excellent memory, calm under pressure, skilled at organizing, great listener
weaknesses: Sometimes too serious, easily overwhelmed by loud crowds, tends to overthink, avoids confrontation, struggles with quick decisions
key_objects: Small leather satchel with scrolls, magnifying glass, favorite reading perch
relationships: Panda is Glaux's closest friend who shares her love of stories. Koala often seeks Glaux's advice when confused. Dinosaur looks up to Glaux as a mentor and tutor.
